JunkRemover - Phone Cleaner & Device Care

Keep your phone clean, fast, and easy to manage.

JunkRemover is a lightweight device care tool designed to help you manage storage, review battery information, test network speed, and clean your speaker with simple tools in one app.

Key Features

Storage Cleaner
Scan cached files and unnecessary junk data, then remove selected items to free up space on your device.
 
Battery Status
View useful battery information and check your device’s current battery
condition.

Network Speed Test
Test your current network download speed and understand your connection
  performance.

Speaker Cleaner
Use sound vibration to help clear dust from the speaker area and keep audio
  playback clearer.

Download JunkRemover to manage your phone more easily and keep your device in better condition.

⚠️ Important Note About the Launcher Feature:
This app includes home screen launcher functionality. After installation and when set as the default home app, your home screen layout may be adjusted to provide faster access to tools. All of your apps remain safely on your device — only their arrangement may change. You can switch back to your original home screen at any time in system settings.
